CursorParams.title: CursorParams

within_km.title: Within Km

alt_text.description: What the image shows, for people using a screen reader

parent_id.description: Reply to a top-level reply (one level deep only)

info.description: Circuit backend. Errors always use {error: {code, message, details}}; lists use {items, count, next_offset}.
info.title: Circuit API

patch.description: The startup's team only. applied can become shortlisted or rejected; shortlisted can become hired or rejected. Other people's applications are a 404. The student is notified.

post.description: Students only, my own application. Safe to repeat. Decided applications are a 409.

Gives the signed-in member beta access, and joins the code's organisation if it has one and they have none. A code that is unknown, expired, used up or revoked all get the same 400 `invalid_code` so the answer never helps guessing. Someone who already has access gets 200 and no code is used. Rate limited per member and per address.

get.description: The fixed list of capabilities used for needs, offers and skills.
Exchange circuits I am part of, newest first, each with everything its screen shows (see One circuit). A proposal nobody finished answering in 72 hours reads as expired.

A circuit I am part of; anyone else's is a 404. One call returns everything the circuit screen and the completion moment need: the three members with their yes and their done, who helps whom (`you_help`, `helps_you`), the time left to answer, what I can do next (`next_step`), each handover with `can_mark_done` and `can_rate`, and ratings (a rating shows only on handovers I give or receive). Realtime: listen to the private channel `circuit:<id>`; an event means refetch.

post.description: The person giving says they have done their part. When all three are done the circuit is completed. Only the giver can do this, and only while the circuit is active. Safe to repeat.
The person receiving rates the handover from 1 to 5, once it is marked done. The first rating stands.

Each of the three people answers within 72 hours. When all three say yes the circuit becomes active; one no ends it for everyone. Answering the same way again is safe; changing your answer is a 409; an expired proposal is a 409.
post.summary: Say yes or no to a circuit

get.description: The cities a member can choose in sign-up, each with its centre point. The pilot city is first.

Public. Environment, whether the invite-only beta is on, whether the caller may get past the beta gate (`beta_access`; false for anonymous visitors while the beta is on) and which features are on for the caller (anonymous visitors get the `everyone` audience). The app hides screens for features that are off.
People I am connected to. Only I see this list; there are no public counts.
box=incoming (default) or outgoing. Pending ones only, newest first.

post.description: With an optional note of up to 300 characters. If they already asked me, this accepts it. A request to or from someone under 18 must stay inside one organisation; anyone I may not reach is a 404.
Only the person it was sent to. Accepting makes us connections.
post.summary: Accept or decline a connection request

get.description: folder=chats (accepted) or requests (first messages from people I am not connected to). Latest first. Members under 18 never get requests from strangers.

post.description: Sends the first message. Connected people chat directly; others receive it as a request. Someone I may not message (under-18 rules, blocks, hidden profiles) is a 404.

get.description: How many chats and requests have something I have not read: for the Inbox tab dot and the desktop rail.
404 unless I am one of the two people.

post.description: Only the person the request was sent to.
Closes the conversation and blocks them everywhere (matches, posts, messages, intros).
'No thanks' to a request I received. It disappears for me; the sender is not told. Only the person the request was sent to; a conversation that is not a request is a 409 `not_a_request`.

get.description: Newest first. Pass next_cursor as cursor to load older ones. `read_at` on my own messages is set only when both of us have read receipts on.

post.description: Text up to 2000 characters, an image, or both. In a request the sender gets one message until the other person answers; answering accepts the request.

get.description: What the client fetches after a Realtime nudge. 404 unless I am in the conversation.

post.description: Marks what the other person sent as read.

get.description: Introductions my members asked for, split into local and Bridge matches, with how many were accepted. The rate appears only when both counts are at least 5.
What my organisation's members need against what they offer, biggest gaps first. Partner admins only, and only for their own organisation. Counts below 5 are hidden.
Members on a grid of roughly 2 km cells; cells with fewer than 5 members are left out. Add capability=<slug> to show only members who need that capability.
Members, new members, matches, introductions, completed circuits and applications for my organisation. Counts below 5 are hidden.
Dev and demo only.

post.description: Dev and demo only.

get.description: Up to 3 people, ready at 08:00 IST, each a Strong or Good match (anything weaker is never dropped). Empty until the daily job has run. Members under 18 get no drop.

post.description: intro or skip. This records the choice only; to ask for the intro, call the intros endpoint next. A person who is not in today's drop is a 404.

get.description: Process is up. Touches no dependencies.
Checks Postgres, Redis and the Supabase JWKS (skipped when SUPABASE_URL is unset). Redis down is degraded, not failed, because Postgres is the source of truth.
box=sent (what I asked for), received (requests that reached me), brokered (where I am the mutual connection). Newest first. can_respond says whether it is my turn to answer.

post.description: Ask for an introduction to someone through my best mutual connection, who is asked first and then the person. 201 for a new request, 200 if one is already open (safe to repeat). At most 3 new requests a week; 409 if the person is not taking more introductions this week. Not available for under-18 accounts. Rate limited.

get.description: How many of this week's introductions I have used and left, and when the next one frees up, so the request sheet can say '2 left' before I press Send. Only about me; how full another person is stays private.
Who would introduce me to this person: the best mutual connection within two hops. 404 if the person is hidden or I have no mutual connection.

post.description: The person who asked rates how it went, 1 to 5. Only after it was accepted. Safe to repeat.
The mutual connection answers first (accepting means vouching), then the person. Answering again is safe. Not my turn is a 409; a request I am not part of is a 404.

get.description: The member's own single-use invite codes with one-tap links to share. Missing codes are created on the way, up to the beta limit (3 by default), so this is safe to call repeatedly.

Open jobs with filters (kind, capability, startup, distance from my location or the city centre, minimum stipend). Students get skill_match (0 to 1) and the best match first; everyone else gets newest first.

post.description: Founders on a claimed startup's team. Needs 1 to 8 capabilities from the fixed list. Marks the startup as hiring.

get.description: The top 3 capabilities asked for by open roles within `within_km` (default 10) of my location or the city centre. Role counts only, never people. Members under 18 count only verified startups' roles.
One job. Students see their skill match and which required skills they have. A closed job is visible to its team only.

patch.description: The startup's team only. Set is_open to false to close it. Changing capabilities re-scores existing applications.

get.description: The startup's team only. Ranked by skill match, then earliest application. College is not shown or used.

post.description: Students only, one click. 201 for a new application, 200 if I had already applied (safe to repeat). A withdrawn application is reopened. Closed jobs are a 409. Rate limited.

get.description: Up to 12 updates from the last 24 hours (shipped, hiring, needs, joined, closed a circuit), most relevant to me first, unseen before seen. Each has one line of what happened, why it matters to me, and one action. No view or reaction counts.

post.description: Call when an update is opened. A key that is not on my wire is a 404.

get.description: People who fit what I need and offer, best first, each with a one-line reason. Computed ahead of time, so this is a cheap read. bridge=true shows only Bridge matches (different sector), bridge=false only the rest. Filters: role, verified (level 2+), capability (a slug they offer) and within_km (5, 10, 25 or 50). The distance itself is never returned. Partner admins and super admins have no matches.

parameters.description: 5, 10, 25 or 50: lives within this distance of my location or the city centre
parameters.name: within_km

schema.description: 5, 10, 25 or 50: lives within this distance of my location or the city centre
schema.title: Within Km

get.description: The signed-in member's own profile and settings. `beta_access` is false while the invite-only beta is on and the member has not got in yet: show the invite-code screen (everything else answers 403 `beta_required`).

patch.description: Send only the fields to change. Role may be student, founder, mentor or investor (admin roles are set by Circuit); under-18 members stay students. Privacy and appearance have their own endpoints; unknown fields are a 422.

Theme (system, dark, light), personal accent (emerald, sky, indigo, rose, lime, mono; the old name 'mint' is still accepted and stored as emerald) and swipe between tabs. Send only the fields to change. Any other value or field is a 422. Stored on the member so it follows them across devices.

get.description: Students: my applications with their status, newest first.
Only the people I blocked, newest first. Who blocked me is never shown.

post.description: Records that I accepted the current Privacy Policy and Terms (policy_version from `/api/me`). Safe to repeat. A version that is not the current one is a 422. Open to members who have not accepted yet and to members without beta access.

Send {"confirm": "DELETE"}. The account is locked at once (every call answers 403 `account_deleted`) and a job removes the sign-in, files, profile, needs, offers and connections, and shows old posts and messages as "Deleted member". Payment records are kept as tax law requires. Startups I claimed pass to another team member or become unclaimed. Safe to repeat. Circuit admins cannot delete themselves here.

get.description: Status of my most recent export (pending, building, ready, failed, expired), or null if I never asked. Open to members who have not accepted the latest policy or have no beta access.

post.description: Starts an export of only my own data (profile, posts, messages I sent, connections, circuits and more) as a zip. A job builds it and emails a link that works for 24 hours. One at a time (409 `export_in_progress`); 3 a day.
post.summary: Ask for a copy of my data

get.description: Send the `token` from the email link while signed in as the same member. Returns a storage link that works for a few minutes. Someone else's token is a 404; an old one is 410 `export_expired`.
get.summary: Get the download link for my export

get.description: Newest first. Only I can see this list.
What I am looking for help with.

put.description: Replaces my needs with this list (max 8, capability slugs from /capabilities). Safe to repeat.

patch.description: Per type (intros, applications, circuits, messages, pulse_replies, announcements) and channel (in_app, email). Send only what changes, e.g. {"intros": {"email": false}}. Account notices (a warning from a moderator) are always shown in the app and cannot be turned off.

get.description: What I can help others with.

put.description: Replaces my offers with this list (max 8, capability slugs from /capabilities). Safe to repeat.

delete.description: Back to the circuit-pattern avatar. Safe to repeat.

put.description: Upload the image first (`POST /api/media/uploads` with purpose `avatar`, PUT the file, then complete) and send its id here. The previous photo is deleted. Someone else's upload is a 404. Under-18 members' photos are shown to nobody but them.

patch.description: Send only the fields to change: profile_visibility (public, members, hidden), visible_to_org, circuits_opt_in (needs verification level 2) and allow_requests (strangers may send requests). Members under 18 can never make the profile public or open requests to strangers: 403 `under_18_restricted`, whatever the client sends. Unknown fields are a 422.

get.description: Everything the Settings screens show, in one call: profile summary (email as a hint only), privacy, appearance, notification preferences per type and channel, how many people I have blocked, my latest data export, which policy version I accepted, and the support and grievance contacts.
Skills with level 1-3 and optional proof link.

put.description: Replaces my skills (max 8). Level 1-3; proof_url is optional proof of work. Safe to repeat.

get.description: Trait slugs I picked.

put.description: Replaces my traits (max 10, slugs from /traits). Safe to repeat.

post.description: Sends a code to a work email (not a personal mailbox). Confirm it to reach verification level 2. Rate limited.
Enter the code from the email. On success you reach verification level 2.

Returns a short-lived signed URL for one JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 5 MB. Upload the file to it, then call complete. The browser resizes to 1440px first; the server re-encodes and removes metadata.
Checks the uploaded file really is an image, strips metadata and stores two sizes. Safe to repeat. Someone else's upload is a 404.

get.description: The whole Profile screen in one call: header (photo, headline, organisation for people in mine), what I can do with them (connect, message, intro via a mutual), mutual connections, needs and offers, skills, a grid of their build logs, closed circuits (mine or a connection's) and, on my own profile, the strength meter with its next step. Hidden, under-18, suspended, blocked and admin accounts are a 404. My own id works too.

delete.description: Lifts my block. A closed chat comes back as a request; the connection is not restored. 404 if I had not blocked them.

post.description: Works both ways: neither of you sees the other in matches, Daily Drop, Pulse, Live wire, intros, circuits or Inbox. Removes the connection, closes the chat, stops pending intros between you and ends shared circuits. Anyone you cannot see or have not been in contact with is a 404. Safe to repeat. Rate limited.

get.description: Newest first, only the ones I am allowed to see. 404 for members I cannot see.

Newest first. Add unread=true for unread only. Each item has the line to show (`text`), who did it (`actor`) and what to open (`target`), so the notification centre needs no follow-up calls. Notifications from people I blocked (or who blocked me) and from features switched off for me are left out.

post.description: Marks all my notifications read. Returns how many changed.

get.description: How many notifications I have not read.

post.description: Marks one of my notifications read. Safe to repeat. Anyone else's id is a 404.

Reads a pasted bio and suggests items from our fixed lists. Nothing is saved: confirm with the PUT endpoints. If the AI is unavailable, source is 'manual' with empty suggestions and the app shows the pickers. Rate limited.
post.summary: Suggest needs and offers from a bio

get.description: Where this member is in sign-up, what they answered, and which screens to show, skip or reorder, in one call. Open while the beta gate is on.

patch.description: Saves the current step and merges answers per step (each answer at most 2,000 characters). `signup_source` is kept from the first call that sends one; later values are ignored. `completed: true` marks onboarding finished. Unknown steps or fields are 422. Rate limited.

post.description: Join an organisation with its invite code. Students, founders, mentors and investors who are not already in one. Rate limited.
Joins the organisation that owns the domain of the email your sign-in provider verified. The email is read from your token, never from the request.
Partner admins cannot leave.

get.description: The organisation I belong to. 404 if none.
Partner admins only. Lists members of their own organisation who chose to be visible to it.

delete.description: Partner admins only. Removes a member from their own organisation; any other id is a 404.

get.description: For 'Where do you study?': up to 10 organisations whose name contains the text (at least 2 characters), best first. Never returns join codes or email domains. Picking one only fills in the college name; joining still needs the organisation's invite code or a verified email on its domain.

post.description: Up to 4 images (each with alt text), 500 characters, 3 capability tags and an optional link. Members under 18 can only post to their organisation.

delete.description: Author only; anyone else gets a 404.

get.description: 404 unless the post's visibility lets me see it. Reaction totals appear only on my own posts.

put.description: Helpful, intro_me or lets_talk. Safe to repeat. Nobody but the author sees totals.

get.description: Oldest first, nested one level. Replies from people I blocked or who blocked me are left out.

post.description: Up to 300 characters. The post's author is notified.

get.description: Chronological, last 7 days, never ranked. Shows what is new since I last marked Pulse as seen; include_seen=true shows earlier items too. Ends with caught_up=true.

post.description: Call when the member reaches the end. The next visit shows only newer items.

delete.description: The reply's author or the post's author. Anyone else gets a 404.

post.description: Goes to the Circuit moderators. You can only report what you can see (anything else is a 404). Reporting the same thing twice returns the open report. Rate limited to 10 a day.
post.summary: Report a post, reply, message, profile or startup

get.description: One call for the Discover search field: up to 10 people (by name), 10 startups (by name or sector) and 10 roles (by title, startup or skill). Hidden, under-18, blocked and deleted people never appear; members under 18 find only their connections and roles at verified startups. Rate limited.
Pins inside a bounding box (max about 2 degrees wide, max 500 pins). Hiring startups come first.
Nearest first. Defaults to my saved location, else the city centre. Filters: hiring, capability of an open role, radius.

Profile, open roles, founders (each with the warm path to them), the latest build log pictures and the logo. Counts one view per member per day. `view_count` and `interest_count` are private: only the startup's team, or a founder looking at an unclaimed page (a reason to claim it, never under 5), get them. Members under 18 see an unverified startup as not hiring, with no roles.

patch.description: Only the team of a claimed startup. Claimed data is never overwritten by anything else.

post.description: Founders only. Sends a code to an email at the startup's own website domain. Rate limited. In dev and demo the code is returned.
Founders only. Enter the emailed code to become the startup's owner (also raises you to verification level 2). Rate limited.
Safe to repeat.
Students only. Tells the startup I'm interested. Safe to repeat.

delete.description: The startup's team only. Safe to repeat.

put.description: The startup's team only. Upload the image first (`POST /api/media/uploads` with purpose `startup_logo`, founders only), then send its id. The previous logo is deleted.

post.description: A question, a correction, a data request or a grievance. Emails the right inbox and sends me an acknowledgement with a reference. 5 a day. Open to members who have not accepted the latest policy or have no beta access.
post.summary: Write to support or the grievance officer

get.description: Public. The support address and the grievance officer's name, email and address (from settings), for the legal pages and the Help screen.
The fixed list of traits.
Public. Shows which email type the link switches off. Changes nothing, so mail scanners that open links are harmless. A tampered or expired token is a 400 `invalid_token`. Rate limited per address.

post.description: Public, one click (also the target of the List-Unsubscribe-Post header). Turns off the email channel of the one notification type in the link and nothing else. Safe to repeat. A tampered or expired token is a 400 `invalid_token`.
post.summary: Unsubscribe from one type of email

post.description: Public, for the landing site. No account needed. Always answers 202 `ok` for a valid request, including when the email is already on the list, so it never reveals who has signed up. Rate limited per address. The app calls this too, from the invite-code screen.
